title: Preservation of a zero column
statement: Let $\mathbb F_2$ be the field with two elements, let $\nu$ be a finite set of variables, and choose a fixed variable, a pivot variable, a pivot equation, and a finite list of equations. If the pivot equation has coefficient zero at the fixed variable and every equation in the list also has coefficient zero there, then after clearing the pivot variable from every equation in the list, every resulting equation still has coefficient zero at the fixed variable.
hypotheses_covered: Pivot coefficient at the fixed variable is zero
Every listed row has coefficient zero at the fixed variable
